placement: P2 masthead vignette, right of the headline (square, shown at 152 x 152 px on the 1920 x 1080 canvas)
scene: The same hotel room door, seen straight on, now standing a little open; warm morning sunlight falls through the gap as a soft pale-yellow wedge across the floor. On the lever door handle hangs one raspberry door hanger with two small OPEN round eyes: awake, please make up the room. Door in plum-grey, wall in light lilac-grey, a folded white towel resting on a small trolley beside the door. Fresh, wide-awake morning mood. Simple, centred composition with calm space around the hanger.
style_spec: Bold flat color-block illustration, no outlines, rounded geometric shapes with generous corner radii, on a warm pillowcase-white ground. Friendly, plain and wide-awake; the mood of a good morning after an honest night. The door hanger must look exactly like the reference mark: a tall raspberry tile with fully rounded corners, a round hole near the top with a thin slit running from the hole to the right edge, and only two small eyes as its face.
negative: no faces other than the hanger's two eyes
no more than one raspberry element per image
